messages:
maria: heads-up — PR #4827 is ready for final review. changes: KV cache eviction tweak + small refactor in batch scheduler. perf numbers attached.

kevin: looking now. is there a regression test for long-seq workloads? :eyes:

jin: added a micro-bench in perf/benchmarks/kv-evict-longseq. link: https://internal.redwood/perf/bench/4827 -> run with `./run_bench --suite kv-evict --seq 8k`

maria: yes, bench included. main difference is on mixed small/long sequences — should improve tail latency but I want to confirm throughput on p3.2xlarge.

kevin: quick skim — diff looks fine. question: why remove the fast-path check in scheduler.cpp line ~214? might affect hot-path. can you leave a comment explaining?

maria: good call. pushed a comment and a short note in PR. the check was redundant after we introduced batch-coalescing earlier. it avoids double-queueing, but we still do the same early-exit in coalesce().

oliver: perf-bot just finished the CI perf run: 1752511002. summary: p50 ~ +1ms, p95 ~ +9ms, throughput -3.4% for batch size 8 on long-seq. memory usage +120MB (on 16GB config). full log: https://internal.redwood/perf/results/1752511002

maria: hmm, expected lower p95. is kv-cache hit-rate changed?

perf-bot: kv_cache_hit_rate: baseline=78.4%, pr=72.1% (mixed workload).

jin: that hit-rate drop could explain p95. the eviction tweak can cause more early evicts under bursty prefixes. I can try adjusting eviction threshold to be more conservative.

kevin: are any of these regressions outside our SLO bounds?

oliver: current SLO: p95 <= 120ms. baseline p95=98ms, pr p95=107ms — still under SLO but larger delta than desired for this change. throughput drop small but measurable.

maria: OK — plan: jin will try threshold+1 tweak and re-run bench. if p95 delta <3ms and throughput drop <1% we can merge. otherwise hold and iterate.

jin: will run an experiment now. I'll post results in thread. ETA ~20m.

kevin: note: I still need to approve after the perf signoff. @maria please ping me when jin posts updated numbers.

maria: yep. also CI lint fixed earlier, so merge should be fast once approvals and perf check clear.

deploy-bot: staged deploy window available tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. add a rollback runbook if we merge.

maria: adding rollback notes to PR description. rollback steps + metric checks.

jin: quick update: ran with eviction_threshold +1; new run 1752513800 -> p95=101ms, p50=+0.5ms, throughput -0.8%, mem +90MB. kv_cache_hit_rate=75.8%. full: https://internal.redwood/perf/results/1752513800

kevin: that looks acceptable to me. @maria you good to merge? :shipit:

maria: good with those numbers. approving now.

kevin: approved. merging after 10m quiet window. I'll trigger merge once sha is green.

maria: thanks all. I'll follow up in the release notes and add the perf graphs to the PR.

oliver: noted — I'll schedule an eyeball on the canary after deploy window.

perf-bot: CI perf run artifacts uploaded: artifacts/perf/4827/*.

maria: thread closed once merged.
